stories.headline: Two tankers hit near the Strait of Hormuz
body: UK maritime authorities say two tankers were struck by unknown projectiles near Khasab, Oman.
Iran says a tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine.
The strait carried nearly a fifth of the world's crude oil before the war.
stories.vc: Attacks keep oil prices and shipping costs high.

stories.headline: FBI crime database suffers a suspected breach
body: The FBI's National Crime Information Center has suffered a suspected breach, US media report.
Trump said 'it's not good' when asked about it.
It's the latest in a string of US government breaches and outages.
stories.vc: Government breaches raise the stakes for cybersecurity spending.

stories.headline: Russian strike on Zelenskyy's hometown kills two
body: A Russian attack on Kryvyi Rih killed two people, including a seven-year-old boy, and wounded 60.
Russian missiles also landed in Poland, a NATO member.

stories.headline: Bengaluru commuters cheer return of bike taxis
body: Commuters tired of steep auto fares welcomed the Supreme Court ruling allowing bike taxis in Karnataka.
Drivers who lost work during the ban are relieved too.
Bike taxis already run in 25 states.
stories.vc: Cheaper rides help daily commuters' budgets.

stories.headline: India's crypto exchanges face stalled withdrawals and hacks
body: Coinbase, CoinDCX and ZebPay have had rupee withdrawal problems, blaming bank partners.
CoinDCX lost about $16 million from retired wallets; Unocoin lost $0.2 million.
The ED has also searched premises linked to CoinDCX and Delta Exchange.
stories.joke: Your keys, your coins, their bank's outage.
stories.vc: Weak banking links make crypto exchanges fragile.
